notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to The Master.
The Master does not have summoning sickness.
You control another creature with power 1 or greater.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and The Master trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Master trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill the creature from your library.
Activate The Master by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
